Trace, implement and test: query

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
select distinct s1.bus_no,
    b.bus_name
from schedule s1
    inner join schedule s2 on s1.source = s2.destination
    and s1.destination = s2.source
    inner join buses b on s1.bus_no = b.bus_no
order by s1.bus_no;

select distinct s1.bus_no,
    b.bus_name
from schedule s1,
    schedule s2,
    buses b
where s1.source = s2.destination
    and s1.destination = s2.source
    and s1.bus_no = b.bus_no
order by s1.bus_no;
